pages.title: A Goal in the Sand
pages.text: Score a Beach Ball in a Beach Goal.

pages.title: A Goal in the Sand
pages.text: Discover a working beach game rather than decoration alone.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Place the ball and push it by walking into it or right-clicking. A real goal triggers a firework; sneak-right-click collects the ball.

pages.title: Tune beach music
pages.text: The Radio plays and cycles its own stations; sneak-use stops it. These are the radio's own controls, not a questbook replacement for music.

pages.title: Score a beach goal
pages.text: Push the Beach Ball by moving into it or right-clicking. Scoring in a goal triggers fireworks; sneak-right-click collects the ball.

pages.title: Reinforce a sandcastle
pages.text: Reinforce a built Sandcastle using a Water Bottle. Current settings govern its destruction; radio use and beach games do not replace this building interaction.
